title: Depthwise Separable Convolution
seoDescription: Factor image convolution into per-channel spatial filters and a pointwise convolution that mixes output channels.
description:
Factor standard 2D convolution into a spatial depthwise filter per input channel followed by a pointwise 1x1 linear projection.

Depthwise separable convolutions reduce computation by roughly 8 to 9 times with negligible loss in representational capacity.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
\mathbf{Y} = \operatorname{Pointwise}\left(\operatorname{Depthwise}(\mathbf{X}, \mathbf{W}_{\text{depth}}), \mathbf{W}_{\text{point}}\right)
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Filter each input channel independently with its corresponding spatial depthwise kernel
2. Apply 1x1 pointwise convolution across depthwise feature maps to mix channels
3. Return filtered multichannel output volume

### Returns
Nested list representing output volume (C_out, H_out, W_out).
